source_slug: 2025-12-18 Cabo Verde advances digitalisation of National Health System (SNS)

fact: The Ministry of Health's terms of reference state that DHIS2, used by the national health service to manage aggregated data, is in production in all SNS structures and for all public health programmes; no count of structures is given, and the document is undated so the published month is used.

The Ministry of Health's terms of reference say DHIS2 for aggregated data is in production in all SNS structures, which places the application in the structures themselves; it does not say in so many words who keys the reports, and the document is undated so the published month is used.

The Ministry of Health's terms of reference state that M1 (Medicine One), the application for the patient's single medical record, is used only in the health structures of the City of Praia, namely its health centres and the central hospital, with no count of sites; the document is undated so the published month is used.

The Ministry of Health's terms of reference give as reasons M1 has not left Praia a licence price it calls excessive, a yearly management and maintenance charge of 19% of the licence fee, dependence on the company for any error, and a network below M1's requirements; the document is undated so the published month is used.

The Ministry of Health's terms of reference list the clinical modules of the SIS (outpatient consultation, emergency, admission with a clinical and nursing record, maternal and child services, electronic prescription) as still to be developed, to give a single digital clinical record within 18 months; the SIS modules in use were billing in all structures and registration on Santiago only. The document is undated so the published month is used.
